messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGE fired for service=metrics-pipeline-prod (prometheus_scrape_missing_metrics). Severity=P1. Pager: @oncall-sre. PD: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-2170004322

oncall-sre: acked. I'm taking this. tl;dr: prometheus scrape errors + backlog in log-ingest, some dashboards missing datapoints.

alex: looking at scrape logs now. early signal looks like repeated 503s from legacy-monitoring-app target. query I ran: 
```
sum(increase(prometheus_scrape_errors_total[5m])) by (job)
```
job=legacy-monitoring-app shows spike ~600 errors in last 10m.

sam: checking kafka consumer lag for metrics-topic. output from consumer group: 
```
GROUP           TOPIC           PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
metrics-consumer metrics          4          1245000         1256500         11500
metrics-consumer metrics          5          1244800         1256400         11600
```
lag ~11.5k across partitions. consumer CPU at 95%.

maria: customer impact: noticed several internal dashboards (billing, usage) missing last ~20m. No direct 5xxs on inference API, but downstream alerting that relies on metrics is noisy -> some customers get delayed alerts. Escalation from support ticket #TKT-5231.

oncall-sre: good summary. initial mitigation plan: 1) pause scraping legacy-monitoring-app (temporary) 2) scale up metrics-consumer deployment by +2 replicas 3) throttle producer if needed, and enable consumer backpressure. Anyone able to run the pause?

alex: I can pause the scrape target now. patching prometheus scrape config via k8s configmap and rolling restart (should be quick). command: 
```bash
kubectl -n monitoring patch cm prometheus-scrapes --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/scrapes.yaml","value":"...removed legacy-monitoring-app..."}]'
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deploy/prometheus-server
```

jack: pd-bot shows escalation to oncall-second after 5m (if not acked). we already acked so fine, but FYI pagerduty-bot logged: "INC-2170004322 escalated to oncall-lead".

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2170004322 acknowledged by oncall-sre. Next escalation at 2026-04-12T15:03:45Z if not resolved.

sam: scaling metrics-consumer now. `kubectl -n ingest scale deploy/metrics-consumer --replicas=4` -> pods spinning up. also increasing consumer heap to reduce GC churn.

oncall-sre: while scaling, apply temporary read-throttle on legacy producer topic to stop growth: `kafka-configs --alter --entity-type topics --entity-name legacy-metrics --add-config retention.ms=600000` (short hack). notify platform afterwards to revert.

alex: scrape paused and prometheus restarted. verifying... prometheus logs show scrape errors drop to near 0 for that job.

maria: support notified customers: message posted to TKT-5231 with ETA ~30m for resolution, noted dashboards will repopulate once consumer catches up. put a status note on status.redwood.ai -> 'degraded metrics pipeline'.

oncall-sre: monitoring shows consumer lag trending down (was 11.6k, now 4k). will keep watchers on. next steps: create a followup runbook item, record exact config changes, and trigger postmortem if this crosses 1h.

jack: adding runbook link: https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/metrics-ingest-backpressure (see section 'paused-scrape -> scale-consumer -> throttle-producer').

oncall-sre: handing off to @sam in 45m for monitoring and to own postmortem notes. I'll update PD incident and set status to "monitoring". thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

sam: took over monitoring at 2170006522. consumer lag now ~1.2k, dashboards starting to show points again. will keep running until stable and then follow up with RCA.

oncall-sre: incident closed in PD once stable; final note: root cause likely an unintended traffic surge from legacy-monitoring-app causing scrape timeouts and downstream consumer pressure. Postmortem ticket: PMT-7892 assigned to alex/sam.
